newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico bank robber killed in own bomb explosion.
newsitem.headline: Mexico bank robber killed in own bomb explosion.

text.p: A bank robber killed himself and injured two tellers on Monday when he detonated a briefcase full of dynamite in a botched bank hold-up, police said.
The unidentified man attempted to hold up a branch of Banamex, the country's biggest bank, in the south of Mexico City, but one of the tellers set off an alarm, bringing in police.
"When the police arrived and told him to put his hands up, he set off the bomb," police spokesman Noel Juarez told reporters, adding that the robber died shortly after being taken to hospital.
The two injured tellers, Alejandra Rubio Ramirez, 24, and Roxana Perez Cortes, 22, were in critical condition, a hospital spokeswoman said.
The hold-up attempt was the latest in a long-running series of bank robberies that has plagued Mexico since its 1994-1995 peso crisis and severe recession.
An officer of the special Bank Security and Protection force told reporters at the scene there have been 403 bank robberies in Mexico this year, 60 of them in Mexico City.
